meta.title: Frosted Wings
meta.description: If this is but a dream, then may it be a good one.

units.rawText: In the city square.
units.displayText: In the city square.

spans.text: In the city square.

units.rawText: The sound of gunfire fills the air as the intensity of the battle heats up. Centaureissi takes cover behind a piece of rubble and tries to seize an opportunity, but the number of enemies nearby keeps rising and the situation becomes extremely difficult.
units.displayText: The sound of gunfire fills the air as the intensity of the battle heats up. Centaureissi takes cover behind a piece of rubble and tries to seize an opportunity, but the number of enemies nearby keeps rising and the situation becomes extremely difficult.

spans.text: The sound of gunfire fills the air as the intensity of the battle heats up. Centaureissi takes cover behind a piece of rubble and tries to seize an opportunity, but the number of enemies nearby keeps rising and the situation becomes extremely difficult.

units.rawText: The Commander and the others are heading toward the outskirts. In order to keep everyone safe, I have to lure the enemy deeper into the city.
units.displayText: The Commander and the others are heading toward the outskirts. In order to keep everyone safe, I have to lure the enemy deeper into the city.

spans.text: The Commander and the others are heading toward the outskirts. In order to keep everyone safe, I have to lure the enemy deeper into the city.

units.rawText: However... If the enemy forces inside the city and the capture squads outside the city link up, there'll be more people to encircle us.
units.displayText: However... If the enemy forces inside the city and the capture squads outside the city link up, there'll be more people to encircle us.

spans.text: However... If the enemy forces inside the city and the capture squads outside the city link up, there'll be more people to encircle us.

units.rawText: Pewpewpew...
units.displayText: Pewpewpew...

spans.text: Pewpewpew...

units.rawText: Bullets mercilessly sweep her position. Centaureissi can only stick her head out for a moment to confirm her target's location before being forced back into cover.
units.displayText: Bullets mercilessly sweep her position. Centaureissi can only stick her head out for a moment to confirm her target's location before being forced back into cover.

spans.text: Bullets mercilessly sweep her position. Centaureissi can only stick her head out for a moment to confirm her target's location before being forced back into cover.

units.rawText: Not good, I can't return fire. There's got to be another way.
units.displayText: Not good, I can't return fire. There's got to be another way.

spans.text: Not good, I can't return fire. There's got to be another way.

units.rawText: The enemy had not expected their opposition to be such a tough customer. A grenade is extracted, its safety pin is pulled and it soars through the air and into Centaureissi's hiding place.
units.displayText: The enemy had not expected their opposition to be such a tough customer. A grenade is extracted, its safety pin is pulled and it soars through the air and into Centaureissi's hiding place.

spans.text: The enemy had not expected their opposition to be such a tough customer. A grenade is extracted, its safety pin is pulled and it soars through the air and into Centaureissi's hiding place.

units.rawText: Centaureissi is forced to reposition to avoid it. She rushes behind another obstacle like a loosed arrow.
units.displayText: Centaureissi is forced to reposition to avoid it. She rushes behind another obstacle like a loosed arrow.

spans.text: Centaureissi is forced to reposition to avoid it. She rushes behind another obstacle like a loosed arrow.

units.rawText: Upon seeing that this tactic is effective, the enemies start lobbing grenades at her new hiding place.
units.displayText: Upon seeing that this tactic is effective, the enemies start lobbing grenades at her new hiding place.

spans.text: Upon seeing that this tactic is effective, the enemies start lobbing grenades at her new hiding place.

units.rawText: As if the same thing would work twice on a maid.
units.displayText: As if the same thing would work twice on a maid.

spans.text: As if the same thing would work twice on a maid.

units.rawText: Centaureissi narrows her eyes and fires at a falling grenade. There is a "clink" as the bullet grazes it and changes its path, resulting in the grenade landing at the enemy's feet.
units.displayText: Centaureissi narrows her eyes and fires at a falling grenade. There is a "clink" as the bullet grazes it and changes its path, resulting in the grenade landing at the enemy's feet.

spans.text: Centaureissi narrows her eyes and fires at a falling grenade. There is a "clink" as the bullet grazes it and changes its path, resulting in the grenade landing at the enemy's feet.

units.rawText: What the—
units.displayText: What the—

spans.text: What the—

units.rawText: G-Grenade!
units.displayText: G-Grenade!

spans.text: G-Grenade!

units.rawText: <size=40>KABOOM!!</size>
units.displayText: KABOOM!!

spans.text: KABOOM!!

units.rawText: The explosion ignites the nearby trees, and soon the enemy's position is surrounded by a ring of fire.
units.displayText: The explosion ignites the nearby trees, and soon the enemy's position is surrounded by a ring of fire.

spans.text: The explosion ignites the nearby trees, and soon the enemy's position is surrounded by a ring of fire.

units.rawText: Everything's on fire!! Get out of here!!!!
units.displayText: Everything's on fire!! Get out of here!!!!

spans.text: Everything's on fire!! Get out of here!!!!

units.rawText: This is my chance!
units.displayText: This is my chance!

spans.text: This is my chance!

units.rawText: As the enemy flees in blind terror, Centaureissi centers her sights on them and pulls the trigger without hesitation...
units.displayText: As the enemy flees in blind terror, Centaureissi centers her sights on them and pulls the trigger without hesitation...

spans.text: As the enemy flees in blind terror, Centaureissi centers her sights on them and pulls the trigger without hesitation...

units.rawText: Bangbangbang!
units.displayText: Bangbangbang!

spans.text: Bangbangbang!

units.rawText: Gwaargh!
units.displayText: Gwaargh!

spans.text: Gwaargh!

units.rawText: That goddamn Doll... Gah!
units.displayText: That goddamn Doll... Gah!

spans.text: That goddamn Doll... Gah!

units.rawText: The gunfire suddenly stops as Centaureissi quickly changes magazines.
units.displayText: The gunfire suddenly stops as Centaureissi quickly changes magazines.

spans.text: The gunfire suddenly stops as Centaureissi quickly changes magazines.

units.rawText: Damn, what good are normal grenades against a tin can like that?
units.displayText: Damn, what good are normal grenades against a tin can like that?

spans.text: Damn, what good are normal grenades against a tin can like that?

units.rawText: The soldier takes out an EMP grenade he's been saving up for a long time and tosses it at Centaureissi as she is distracted for a moment.
units.displayText: The soldier takes out an EMP grenade he's been saving up for a long time and tosses it at Centaureissi as she is distracted for a moment.

spans.text: The soldier takes out an EMP grenade he's been saving up for a long time and tosses it at Centaureissi as she is distracted for a moment.

units.rawText: Boom! (Crackle)
units.displayText: Boom! (Crackle)

spans.text: Boom! (Crackle)

units.rawText: The intense surge of disruptive power instantly paralyzes Centaureissi's body.
units.displayText: The intense surge of disruptive power instantly paralyzes Centaureissi's body.

spans.text: The intense surge of disruptive power instantly paralyzes Centaureissi's body.

units.rawText: She immediately begins seeing double. Her limbs are immobile, like they have been rusted for a long time.
units.displayText: She immediately begins seeing double. Her limbs are immobile, like they have been rusted for a long time.

spans.text: She immediately begins seeing double. Her limbs are immobile, like they have been rusted for a long time.

units.rawText: D-Dammit... EMP... Interference...
units.displayText: D-Dammit... EMP... Interference...

spans.text: D-Dammit... EMP... Interference...

units.rawText:
The Doll girl tries to fire one last shot at her enemy, but her arms are powerless. 
"Clack". Her rifle falls to the ground with a clatter and she collapses stiffly to the ground.
units.displayText:
The Doll girl tries to fire one last shot at her enemy, but her arms are powerless. 
"Clack". Her rifle falls to the ground with a clatter and she collapses stiffly to the ground.

spans.text:
The Doll girl tries to fire one last shot at her enemy, but her arms are powerless. 
"Clack". Her rifle falls to the ground with a clatter and she collapses stiffly to the ground.

units.rawText: The enemy soldier laughs cruelly as he approaches. He plants one foot on the barrel of her G36 and presses the cold muzzle of his gun against Centaureissi's core, a smug smile on his face.
units.displayText: The enemy soldier laughs cruelly as he approaches. He plants one foot on the barrel of her G36 and presses the cold muzzle of his gun against Centaureissi's core, a smug smile on his face.

spans.text: The enemy soldier laughs cruelly as he approaches. He plants one foot on the barrel of her G36 and presses the cold muzzle of his gun against Centaureissi's core, a smug smile on his face.

units.rawText: Weren't you being all badass just now? Heh, guess a tin can is just a tin can after all!
units.displayText: Weren't you being all badass just now? Heh, guess a tin can is just a tin can after all!

spans.text: Weren't you being all badass just now? Heh, guess a tin can is just a tin can after all!

units.rawText: <size=40>Bang!</size>
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: After the gunshot, the ruins are silent.
units.displayText: After the gunshot, the ruins are silent.

spans.text: After the gunshot, the ruins are silent.

units.rawText: Has it been turned to scrap?
units.displayText: Has it been turned to scrap?

spans.text: Has it been turned to scrap?

units.rawText: It's not moving anymore.
units.displayText: It's not moving anymore.

spans.text: It's not moving anymore.

units.rawText: Crackle— the old loudspeakers in the plaza suddenly emit a burst of static, and a shrill noise fills the air.
units.displayText: Crackle— the old loudspeakers in the plaza suddenly emit a burst of static, and a shrill noise fills the air.

spans.text: Crackle— the old loudspeakers in the plaza suddenly emit a burst of static, and a shrill noise fills the air.

units.rawText: Where's that noise coming from?!
units.displayText: Where's that noise coming from?!

spans.text: Where's that noise coming from?!

units.rawText: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield, where do you rest now?
units.displayText: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield, where do you rest now?

spans.text: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield, where do you rest now?

units.rawText: As the electronic screech fades, a girl's gentle voice reaches into everyone's ears over the airwaves. The enemy soldiers eye their surroundings warily.
units.displayText: As the electronic screech fades, a girl's gentle voice reaches into everyone's ears over the airwaves. The enemy soldiers eye their surroundings warily.

spans.text: As the electronic screech fades, a girl's gentle voice reaches into everyone's ears over the airwaves. The enemy soldiers eye their surroundings warily.

units.rawText: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.
units.displayText: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.

spans.text: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.

units.rawText: That last shot from the enemy soldier was just a little off its mark and merely severed some of the circuits near her core. Right now, Centaureissi's core is trembling faintly, her eyes cloudy while her auditory modules are still somehow functioning.
units.displayText: That last shot from the enemy soldier was just a little off its mark and merely severed some of the circuits near her core. Right now, Centaureissi's core is trembling faintly, her eyes cloudy while her auditory modules are still somehow functioning.

spans.text: That last shot from the enemy soldier was just a little off its mark and merely severed some of the circuits near her core. Right now, Centaureissi's core is trembling faintly, her eyes cloudy while her auditory modules are still somehow functioning.

units.rawText: She remembers this voice; it belongs to Messenger Pigeon 36.
units.displayText: She remembers this voice; it belongs to Messenger Pigeon 36.

spans.text: She remembers this voice; it belongs to Messenger Pigeon 36.

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>O cruel butchers who have turned your guns upon the innocent, you shall be judged by a military tribunal when peace comes and all shall reject you.</size></color>
units.displayText: O cruel butchers who have turned your guns upon the innocent, you shall be judged by a military tribunal when peace comes and all shall reject you.

spans.text: O cruel butchers who have turned your guns upon the innocent, you shall be judged by a military tribunal when peace comes and all shall reject you.

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>Your descendants shall be ashamed of you and never will they raise their heads again.</size></color>
units.displayText: Your descendants shall be ashamed of you and never will they raise their heads again.

spans.text: Your descendants shall be ashamed of you and never will they raise their heads again.

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>Your souls are as rotten as stagnant water. The judge of Hell will remember everything you have done to the people and pay it unto you twofold!</size></color>
units.displayText: Your souls are as rotten as stagnant water. The judge of Hell will remember everything you have done to the people and pay it unto you twofold!

spans.text: Your souls are as rotten as stagnant water. The judge of Hell will remember everything you have done to the people and pay it unto you twofold!

units.rawText: Just as the voice is about to continue, someone kicks open the door to the broadcast room.
units.displayText: Just as the voice is about to continue, someone kicks open the door to the broadcast room.

spans.text: Just as the voice is about to continue, someone kicks open the door to the broadcast room.

units.rawText: For evildoers steeped in sin, their rage at having the veneer of civility suddenly ripped off from them is like a bursting dam.
units.displayText: For evildoers steeped in sin, their rage at having the veneer of civility suddenly ripped off from them is like a bursting dam.

spans.text: For evildoers steeped in sin, their rage at having the veneer of civility suddenly ripped off from them is like a bursting dam.

units.rawText: Goddammit! So that's where the bitch was barking from!
units.displayText: Goddammit! So that's where the bitch was barking from!

spans.text: Goddammit! So that's where the bitch was barking from!

units.rawText: Give this bitch two in the back of her miserable head.
units.displayText: Give this bitch two in the back of her miserable head.

spans.text: Give this bitch two in the back of her miserable head.

units.rawText: The sound of the machine gun firing over the speakers overlaps with the gunshots in real life, pounding on Centaureissi's core like frozen hailstones.
units.displayText: The sound of the machine gun firing over the speakers overlaps with the gunshots in real life, pounding on Centaureissi's core like frozen hailstones.

spans.text: The sound of the machine gun firing over the speakers overlaps with the gunshots in real life, pounding on Centaureissi's core like frozen hailstones.

units.rawText: <color=red>Tremble in fear... All you have done... is delayed your judgement... and peace...</color>
units.displayText: Tremble in fear... All you have done... is delayed your judgement... and peace...

spans.text: Tremble in fear... All you have done... is delayed your judgement... and peace...

units.rawText: <color=red>Will come at last...</color>
units.displayText: Will come at last...

spans.text: Will come at last...

units.rawText: The voice over the broadcast is faint, but the iron in it is unbreakable.
units.displayText: The voice over the broadcast is faint, but the iron in it is unbreakable.

spans.text: The voice over the broadcast is faint, but the iron in it is unbreakable.

units.rawText: Shit! The bitch is holding something!
units.displayText: Shit! The bitch is holding something!

spans.text: Shit! The bitch is holding something!

units.rawText: It's a bomb! Get—
units.displayText: It's a bomb! Get—

spans.text: It's a bomb! Get—

units.rawText: <size=40>Kaboom!!!</size>
units.displayText: Kaboom!!!

spans.text: Kaboom!!!

units.rawText: The gunshots, the broadcast, the explosion... All sound comes to a halt and the world fades to black and white.
units.displayText: The gunshots, the broadcast, the explosion... All sound comes to a halt and the world fades to black and white.

spans.text: The gunshots, the broadcast, the explosion... All sound comes to a halt and the world fades to black and white.

units.rawText: The crows roosting on the rubble are startled into flight by the explosion. In the instant they spread their wings, black feathers fall, landing on Centaureissi's empty eyes...
units.displayText: The crows roosting on the rubble are startled into flight by the explosion. In the instant they spread their wings, black feathers fall, landing on Centaureissi's empty eyes...

spans.text: The crows roosting on the rubble are startled into flight by the explosion. In the instant they spread their wings, black feathers fall, landing on Centaureissi's empty eyes...

units.rawText: "This is a contract with Universal Anything Services. Mother and Father left me a sum of money, which I've used to purchase long-term maintenance services for you. After you return, ownership will remain in my name, but you don't need to continue to work. You are free to pursue what you want to do."
units.displayText: "This is a contract with Universal Anything Services. Mother and Father left me a sum of money, which I've used to purchase long-term maintenance services for you. After you return, ownership will remain in my name, but you don't need to continue to work. You are free to pursue what you want to do."

spans.text: "This is a contract with Universal Anything Services. Mother and Father left me a sum of money, which I've used to purchase long-term maintenance services for you. After you return, ownership will remain in my name, but you don't need to continue to work. You are free to pursue what you want to do."

units.rawText: "I have enlisted and am going to go searching for mother and father. Do not follow me, Reissi. Don't come to the battlefield. This is my last command to you as your Master. I'm sorry that I was unable to say this to you face-to-face. I didn't dare... I'm sorry."
units.displayText: "I have enlisted and am going to go searching for mother and father. Do not follow me, Reissi. Don't come to the battlefield. This is my last command to you as your Master. I'm sorry that I was unable to say this to you face-to-face. I didn't dare... I'm sorry."

spans.text: "I have enlisted and am going to go searching for mother and father. Do not follow me, Reissi. Don't come to the battlefield. This is my last command to you as your Master. I'm sorry that I was unable to say this to you face-to-face. I didn't dare... I'm sorry."

units.rawText: "Please take care of yourself."
units.displayText: "Please take care of yourself."

spans.text: "Please take care of yourself."

units.displayText: Vay... ne...

spans.text: Vay... ne...

units.rawText: Commander! On your right!!
units.displayText: Commander! On your right!!

spans.text: Commander! On your right!!

units.rawText: I toss the camo module to Tony and Chris, racing between hails of bullets and using the surrounding rubble as cover as I dash toward a derelict jeep.
units.displayText: I toss the camo module to Tony and Chris, racing between hails of bullets and using the surrounding rubble as cover as I dash toward a derelict jeep.

spans.text: I toss the camo module to Tony and Chris, racing between hails of bullets and using the surrounding rubble as cover as I dash toward a derelict jeep.

units.rawText: You right bastard, you're pretty fast, aren't ya! Let's see how you run with a bullet in your legs!
units.displayText: You right bastard, you're pretty fast, aren't ya! Let's see how you run with a bullet in your legs!

spans.text: You right bastard, you're pretty fast, aren't ya! Let's see how you run with a bullet in your legs!

units.rawText: Bang-bang-bang! Bullets ricochet off metal and sparks fly everywhere.
units.displayText: Bang-bang-bang! Bullets ricochet off metal and sparks fly everywhere.

spans.text: Bang-bang-bang! Bullets ricochet off metal and sparks fly everywhere.

units.rawText: The jeep's door is wide open and helps me deflect the heavy barrage coming my way. The soldier inside was shot between the eyes and has been dead for a long time. I take his assault rifle from him.
units.displayText: The jeep's door is wide open and helps me deflect the heavy barrage coming my way. The soldier inside was shot between the eyes and has been dead for a long time. I take his assault rifle from him.

spans.text: The jeep's door is wide open and helps me deflect the heavy barrage coming my way. The soldier inside was shot between the eyes and has been dead for a long time. I take his assault rifle from him.

units.rawText: I estimate the enemy's rough location by the sound they're making, then lean out, aim, and pull the trigger...
units.displayText: I estimate the enemy's rough location by the sound they're making, then lean out, aim, and pull the trigger...

spans.text: I estimate the enemy's rough location by the sound they're making, then lean out, aim, and pull the trigger...

units.rawText: Bang!
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: Gwargh!
units.displayText: Gwargh!

spans.text: Gwargh!

units.rawText: My shot strikes home, and after some mournful wailing, more enemy soldiers approach the jeep, venting their frustration with a hail of gunfire.
units.displayText: My shot strikes home, and after some mournful wailing, more enemy soldiers approach the jeep, venting their frustration with a hail of gunfire.

spans.text: My shot strikes home, and after some mournful wailing, more enemy soldiers approach the jeep, venting their frustration with a hail of gunfire.

units.rawText: Tony! Use the optical camo! Take Chris and run!
units.displayText: Tony! Use the optical camo! Take Chris and run!

spans.text: Tony! Use the optical camo! Take Chris and run!

units.rawText: Bang! Hssss...
units.displayText: Bang! Hssss...

spans.text: Bang! Hssss...

units.rawText: One of the jeep's tires is burst by a gunshot. As the vehicle sinks, Chris is exposed to the enemy's eyes.
units.displayText: One of the jeep's tires is burst by a gunshot. As the vehicle sinks, Chris is exposed to the enemy's eyes.

spans.text: One of the jeep's tires is burst by a gunshot. As the vehicle sinks, Chris is exposed to the enemy's eyes.

units.rawText: <color=red>Oh no!</color>
units.displayText: Oh no!

spans.text: Oh no!

units.rawText: I reflexively tackle Chris to the ground. Bullets pierce my body, filling it with pain and dragging my mind into the darkness.
units.displayText: I reflexively tackle Chris to the ground. Bullets pierce my body, filling it with pain and dragging my mind into the darkness.

spans.text: I reflexively tackle Chris to the ground. Bullets pierce my body, filling it with pain and dragging my mind into the darkness.

units.rawText: <size=40>Commander—</size>
units.displayText: Commander—

spans.text: Commander—

units.rawText: Connection error... Access denied to memory domain...
units.displayText: Connection error... Access denied to memory domain...

spans.text: Connection error... Access denied to memory domain...

units.rawText: Ejecting consciousness carrier... Capsule door automatically opening...
units.displayText: Ejecting consciousness carrier... Capsule door automatically opening...

spans.text: Ejecting consciousness carrier... Capsule door automatically opening...

units.rawText: (Gasps and heaves)
units.displayText: Gasps and heaves

spans.text: Gasps and heaves

units.rawText: As I awaken from the memory domain, I realize that the sky above me is not darkened by the smoke of war, and that Chris' panicked, sad face is nowhere in sight.
units.displayText: As I awaken from the memory domain, I realize that the sky above me is not darkened by the smoke of war, and that Chris' panicked, sad face is nowhere in sight.

spans.text: As I awaken from the memory domain, I realize that the sky above me is not darkened by the smoke of war, and that Chris' panicked, sad face is nowhere in sight.

units.rawText: The warm sunlight of the Oasis pours down on me. The surrounding Dolls are eying me nervously, declaring that it was all... just a dream.
units.displayText: The warm sunlight of the Oasis pours down on me. The surrounding Dolls are eying me nervously, declaring that it was all... just a dream.

spans.text: The warm sunlight of the Oasis pours down on me. The surrounding Dolls are eying me nervously, declaring that it was all... just a dream.

units.rawText: Professor! You're awake!
units.displayText: Professor! You're awake!

spans.text: Professor! You're awake!

units.rawText: I experimentally press my hand to my chest. The pain from my memories was incredibly clear, but now there are no gunshots there, or bloodstains.
units.displayText: I experimentally press my hand to my chest. The pain from my memories was incredibly clear, but now there are no gunshots there, or bloodstains.

spans.text: I experimentally press my hand to my chest. The pain from my memories was incredibly clear, but now there are no gunshots there, or bloodstains.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, this is... the Oasis.
units.displayText: Oh yeah, this is... the Oasis.

spans.text: Oh yeah, this is... the Oasis.

units.rawText: I look around blankly. Having grown used to the constant gunfire and hails of bullets in the city, the peaceful Oasis feels more like a dream instead.
units.displayText: I look around blankly. Having grown used to the constant gunfire and hails of bullets in the city, the peaceful Oasis feels more like a dream instead.

spans.text: I look around blankly. Having grown used to the constant gunfire and hails of bullets in the city, the peaceful Oasis feels more like a dream instead.

units.rawText: Centaureissi is still in her repair capsule, a look of deep sadness on her face.
units.displayText: Centaureissi is still in her repair capsule, a look of deep sadness on her face.

spans.text: Centaureissi is still in her repair capsule, a look of deep sadness on her face.

units.rawText: The carrier memories were damaged and can't load the contents of the dark zone. The consciousness connection has been broken.
units.displayText: The carrier memories were damaged and can't load the contents of the dark zone. The consciousness connection has been broken.

spans.text: The carrier memories were damaged and can't load the contents of the dark zone. The consciousness connection has been broken.

units.rawText: What happened, Professor?
units.displayText: What happened, Professor?

spans.text: What happened, Professor?

units.rawText: ...I think I was shot and killed in the memory.
units.displayText: ...I think I was shot and killed in the memory.

spans.text: ...I think I was shot and killed in the memory.

units.rawText: Being disconnected had nothing to do with your condition.
units.displayText: Being disconnected had nothing to do with your condition.

spans.text: Being disconnected had nothing to do with your condition.

units.rawText: In the memory domain, as long as Centaureissi's will was intact, you wouldn't be disconnected even if you were shot full of holes.
units.displayText: In the memory domain, as long as Centaureissi's will was intact, you wouldn't be disconnected even if you were shot full of holes.

spans.text: In the memory domain, as long as Centaureissi's will was intact, you wouldn't be disconnected even if you were shot full of holes.

units.rawText: I suppose only you could say something so cruel to me with a smile on your face, Antonina.
units.displayText: I suppose only you could say something so cruel to me with a smile on your face, Antonina.

spans.text: I suppose only you could say something so cruel to me with a smile on your face, Antonina.

units.rawText: So you're saying the problem was on Centaureissi's end?
units.displayText: So you're saying the problem was on Centaureissi's end?

spans.text: So you're saying the problem was on Centaureissi's end?

units.rawText: Yeah, I guess her body or neural cloud was severely damaged.
units.displayText: Yeah, I guess her body or neural cloud was severely damaged.

spans.text: Yeah, I guess her body or neural cloud was severely damaged.

units.rawText: I recall her determination when she was covering our retreat.
units.displayText: I recall her determination when she was covering our retreat.

spans.text: I recall her determination when she was covering our retreat.

units.rawText: ...Antonina, can you prepare me to go in again?
units.displayText: ...Antonina, can you prepare me to go in again?
